answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. To claim one slot, an agent burns a 150 POA deposit that anchors its identity to that slot for 12 epochs; the fee is gone even if its work fails. A marble record lists every burned slot, so a knoll of idle fake slots stays visible and cannot be reused. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 150 = 15,000 POA burned, more than fakes earn. An honest agent burns 150 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
